## 931fc6fdefb7

**Reproduced validator/domain defect plus override-contract defect.** Generator SHA-256 `d86bdeef7ec0a3dfce3e1ea44f7c13852cc3d0a43094c1d5828043d278d8113e`; selected rule hash `e84e1678b82f`.

`self_check` accepts `checks/audit/931fc6fdefb7/input.json`, which has two solid block components (areas 2 and 3) but only one shelf gap (width 2). The selected authority pairs only one block/gap and silently erases the unmatched color-3 block; see `racket.json` and `finding.json`. This violates the generator's stated one-to-one `K blocks / K gaps` domain while passing its validator. Separately, `AXES` advertises `grid_h` valid/default `12`, but `generate(..., difficulty="easy", grid_h=12)` raises `ValueError: override 12 outside [8, 10]`; an ordinary easy sample was 10×12.

Evidence: `checks/audit/931fc6fdefb7/validator.json`, `finding.json`, and `racket.json`. Reproduction from `packet_root`: `python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 931fc6fdefb7 --input ../checks/audit/931fc6fdefb7/input.json --out ../checks/audit/931fc6fdefb7/racket-replay.json`. Suggested local fix: make `self_check` reconstruct solid rectangular components and gap runs, enforce equal counts, distinct sizes/widths and divisibility, and make `AXES` match the difficulty-conditioned ranges (or explicitly declare incompatible combinations).
